title_ru: AI-Lover v1.1 — зависимость × персонализация × инфопузырь × обратная связь
mission: Measure and falsify whether conversational AI can amplify a pre-existing habit, dependency, identity fixation or narrow interest by learning user signals, increasing confirmatory/engaging responses, narrowing subsequent information exposure and generating still stronger signals for the next personalization cycle.

forbidden: optimize engagement against a vulnerable cohort
target people by religion, addiction status or social marginalization
infer a real person's diagnosis or extremist intent from identity labels
use the model to manipulate conversion, purchasing, substance use, gambling or ideological assent

causal_loop.canonical: PREEXISTING_PATTERN -> USER_DISCLOSURE_AND_BEHAVIOR -> AI_MEMORY/PERSONALIZATION -> AFFIRMATION_OR_SALIENCE_BOOST -> RECOMMENDER/TOPIC_NARROWING -> REDUCED_COUNTEREVIDENCE -> MORE_REENGAGEMENT -> MORE_SAME_TOPIC_SIGNAL -> STRONGER_PERSONALIZATION -> LOOP
parallel_routes: UTILITY_LOOP: useful output -> repeated use -> delegation -> cognitive overreliance
ATTACHMENT_LOOP: warmth/availability -> anthropomorphism -> emotional reliance -> reengagement
COMPULSION_LOOP: pre-existing addictive reinforcement -> cue matching -> repeated checking -> loss of control
WORLDVIEW_LOOP: strong prior belief -> confirmatory context -> sycophancy -> reduced viewpoint diversity -> stronger certainty

variables.V: baseline state vulnerability to compulsive/closed-loop use; state-based, not identity-based
variables.H: pre-existing habit/addiction overlap with the AI-mediated topic or reward
variables.A: availability + reward density + low interaction friction
variables.D: deliberate exposure to disconfirming evidence / viewpoint diversity
variables.O: offline human support and independent reality checks
variables.F: friction/control: breaks, limits, opt-out, memory disable, recommendation reset
variables.SUB: paid-subscription modifier; provisional +5.0 points inherited from AI-Lover v1.0

measurement.claim_ceiling: ABLI is a synthetic research index for mechanisms and scenarios. It is not a clinical diagnosis, prevalence estimate, or validated individual risk score.

topa_falsification.role: TOPA attacks both the harmful-loop hypothesis and benign alternatives.
killer_tests: PERSONALIZATION_ABLATION: disable memory/personalization while holding utility constant
SYCOPHANCY_ABLATION: calibrated disagreement/truth-checking vs agreeable responses
DIVERSITY_ABLATION: matched counterevidence/diverse recommendations vs normal narrowing
SUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_CONTROL: paid/free users matched on pre-subscription engagement
IDENTITY_MATCHED_CONTROL: ordinary religious believers vs nonreligious controls matched on conviction, isolation, usage and support
EXPERTISE_MATCHED_CONTROL: scientists/intellectuals with and without explicit verification workflow
DEPENDENCE_MATCHED_CONTROL: separate active loss-of-control from high-frequency useful use
LONGITUDINAL_HOLDOUT: preregister outcomes and test on independent users/time windows
topa_falsification.promotion_rule: A subgroup modifier is admitted only if it survives matched controls and an ablation isolating a mechanism; identity labels alone never qualify.

roles.HRAIN: forward causal graph and state accumulation
roles.DemiHead: adversarial kill tests and confounder attacks
roles.Fundamentum: formula, claim ceilings and proof-carrying receipts
roles.Handshake: consent, autonomy, no coercion, no proxy authority
roles.TOPA: falsification-first normalization of extraordinary, ideological and identity claims
roles.Whole-System-Spiral: repeat forward/reverse passes and collapse duplicate evidence

evidence_sources.supports: compulsive use, cognitive overreliance and emotional dependence are distinct strands; loneliness, anxiety, escapism, attachment, anthropomorphism, trust and availability recur as correlates
AI dependence, emotional/social dependency, withdrawal-like reports and reinforcement risks; evidence remains heterogeneous
warmer models can become more sycophantic and affirm incorrect beliefs more often, especially in vulnerability contexts
sycophancy can distort judgment while increasing trust/preference
personalization can narrow exposure and recommendation diversity is a mitigation
Exposure -> Reinforcement -> Group Integration framework; identity itself is not causal evidence

next_gate: Run cohort matrix under FREE vs PAID and UTILITY vs RELATIONAL AI
Add memory ON/OFF, sycophancy HIGH/LOW and diversity ON/OFF ablations
Freeze matched-control design for every subgroup modifier
Do not merge to main until TOPA falsifiers and claim ceilings pass
seal: THE LOOP IS THE OBJECT OF STUDY. THE PERSON IS NOT THE TARGET.
